recipes.site-playbooks-airbnb: Search dated rentals for guests and filters, then open one listing. Report matching amenities, availability, total and cancellation terms, distinguishing nightly prices from complete quotes.
recipes.site-playbooks-bestbuy: Search by name and check a selected SKU's store-specific stock by ZIP. Verify model, fulfillment, price and store, including ambiguous or unavailable inventory.
recipes.site-playbooks-costco: Verify online item price and reported warehouse availability separately, then build a Same-Day grocery cart with chosen quantities. Show actual basket and membership-dependent limits.
recipes.site-playbooks-craigslist: Search the requested city/category and filters. Return current postings, prices, neighborhoods, dates and links from that location, with no unsolicited contact.
recipes.site-playbooks-doordash: Discover stores by address, extract a specific menu, build a customized pickup/delivery cart, then resume that cart only after the exact review. Verify receipt and handle changed merchant, address or total.
recipes.site-playbooks-ebay: Search active and sold listings by selected filters and inspect one item. Return item ID, condition, seller, offer type, shipping and total. Distinguish asking price from sold data.
recipes.site-playbooks-etsy: Filter by product, price and fulfillment. Verify shop, listing, price, reviews and sponsored status. Keep selected variants and shipping destinations explicit.
recipes.site-playbooks-expedia: Compare dated lodging and flight inventory for the named party, with total, fees and flexible-date options where displayed. A comparison ends at a reproducible shortlist.
recipes.site-playbooks-facebook-marketplace: Search the correct city/radius/category or inspect an item URL. Return price, location, date and available details. Respect account-gated results and authorized contact.
recipes.site-playbooks-fedex: Read current status, delivery window, last scan, timeline and signer when available for an authorized number. Distinguish still in transit, delivered and unknown.
recipes.site-playbooks-google-flights: Compare one-way and round-trip fixed-date results, reporting airports, times, airlines, stops, duration, fare and link exactly as available.
recipes.site-playbooks-instacart: In the selected store/region, quote exact items, size, deals and subtotal and add only requested quantities to a guest cart. Verify cart, substitutions and checkout boundary.
recipes.site-playbooks-linkedin: Search jobs by role, location and recency, verify listing and employer URLs, distinguish public results from personalized signed-in inventory and closed positions.
recipes.site-playbooks-luma: Discover by city/category, inspect a specific event and run its registration route. Verify timezone, venue, host, ticket state and actual RSVP/approval/waitlist. Paid tickets use purchase review.
recipes.site-playbooks-opentable: Read availability with exact venue, party, date, time and seating labels. On a booking request, verify the selected slot, restrictions/deposit and resulting confirmation.
recipes.site-playbooks-realtor: Search and inspect one property, verify property attributes, listing identifier and dated price. Separately retrieve attributed school-rating data and mark absent ratings unknown.
recipes.site-playbooks-resy: Read slots by date, party size and seating type. Explain unpublished, sold-out or ambiguous results, verify exact reservation after review and keep fees visible.
recipes.site-playbooks-southwest: Check route, dates, passengers, currency or points. Return actual fare columns, routing and stops, plus low-fare calendar when requested and available.
recipes.site-playbooks-target: Resolve the actual product/TCIN and variant, detect substituted search results, then verify store, pickup and other fulfillment options for the chosen ZIP.
recipes.site-playbooks-united: Check cash and award availability independently. Return dated cabin/fare brand, price or miles plus fees, stops, routing and availability, marking signed-in-only results appropriately.
recipes.site-playbooks-ups: Track an authorized tracking/InfoNotice number. Verify the latest event, delivery estimate/actual, signer if shown and timeline, leaving shipment options untouched.
recipes.site-playbooks-usps: Verify latest event, expected delivery, status category, location and event history for an authorized parcel. Unknown numbers must not create a delivery forecast.
